obligations.text: A `case_regressions` clause without `unresolved` is evaluated exactly as spec 064 states, and a gate without it has the same canonical bytes, identity, selection bytes, stdout and exit code as before this spec.

Under `exclude_failed_within_integrity`, a case is excluded only when it would be unresolved under 064 3.2.5 and, on each side, it is either measured with a known value in every run or every run lacking a measure for it counts it as an upstream failure under 065 3.2.2 or 3.2.4 with no unknown measure in any run; an excluded case is never compared, never counted as a regression or a non-regression, and is listed with its excused side, the baseline when both sides are excused.

`exclude_failed_within_integrity` is refused unless the gate declares `integrity.max_upstream_failures`, so a case is excluded only in a run that 065 has already found within its upstream-failure bound; a run in breach still voids the comparison before any clause is read.

sectionHeadings: 074: Selection gate: case regressions may leave out cases that failed within the integrity allowance (amends 064 and 065)
record.summary: An amendment of approved specs 064 (3.1, 3.2.5, 3.5, 3.6) and 065 (3.3.4), for #597, ratified by the owner on 2026-11-24 (A-94) for release 0.8.0. A selection gate that declares both a spec 065 `integrity` allowance for upstream failures and a spec 064 `case_regressions` clause can never qualify a candidate that uses the allowance: a case that failed upstream has no measure on that side, so 064 makes it `unpaired` or `partial`, the clause is unknown unless it already fails, and the candidate ends `unknown` (exit 12) or `rejected`. This spec adds an opt-in member to the clause, `unresolved: "exclude_failed_within_integrity"`, allowed only when the gate declares `integrity.max_upstream_failures`. With it, a case that would be unresolved only because of upstream failures that 065 counts is left out of the clause and counted as `excluded`, never compared and never a regression or a non-regression; every other unresolved case keeps 064's meaning. Without the member, every gate, selection, stdout and exit code keeps its bytes.
